acceptance.given: A package contains supplied FAQ entries and declares stable error IDs and decision branches.

oracle.expected: Every supplied FAQ entry has an inbound reference from a declared stable error ID or decision branch and resolves to a local target.
forbidden: A supplied FAQ entry is orphaned.
A supplied FAQ entry has no inbound path from a declared stable error ID or decision branch.
oracle.observable: The validator emits a reachability report mapping each supplied FAQ entry to a declared source and resolvable local target.

acceptance.then: All supplied FAQ entries are verified reachable from declared stable errors or decision branches.
acceptance.when: Run FAQ reachability and local-target validation over the complete supplied FAQ set.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Run the reachability check on a supplied entry with no inbound declared error or decision-branch reference; the structural report must fail and identify the orphan.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Require every supplied FAQ entry to be reachable from a declared stable error ID or decision branch and resolve locally.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: Maintain FAQ optionality and validator output compatibility.

slice_hint.state_transition: The supplied FAQ set transitions from potentially orphaned to reachability-verified.
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: Every supplied FAQ entry has an inbound declared source and local target, with no orphan findings.
